changeSet.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS academic;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academic.pending_transfer ( id_pending_transfer UUID PRIMARY KEY, id_user_app UUID NOT NULL, current_chip_id UUID NOT NULL, proposed_chip_id UUID NOT NULL, source_row INTEGER NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', created_at TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP, created_by VARCHAR(100), updated_by VARCHAR(100), deleted_at TIMESTAMP, deleted_by VARCHAR(100), CONSTRAINT fk_pending_transfer_user FOREIGN KEY (id_user_app) REFERENCES security.user_app (id_user_app), CONSTRAINT fk_pending_transfer_current_chip FOREIGN KEY (current_chip_id) REFERENCES academic.chip (id_chip), CONSTRAINT fk_pending_transfer_proposed_chip FOREIGN KEY (proposed_chip_id) REFERENCES academic.chip (id_chip) );
